name: Being Rich
overview: Scripture presents a sober perspective on being rich, warning believers not to labor solely for wealth or trust in their own wisdom (Proverbs 23:4). While obedience to God's covenant can lead to prosperity (Deuteronomy 29:9), riches carry spiritual risks, as Jesus teaches that it is difficult for the rich to enter God's kingdom (Matthew 19:24) and pronounces woe upon those who find their consolation in wealth (Luke 6:24). The example of the rich man in Luke 16:19 and the reference to the rich in Isaiah 53:9 further illustrate the complex relationship between riches and righteousness, emphasizing that true value is found in godly character rather than material abundance.
